title: Impact of Construction Materials Used for HDB Flats on Noise Transmission
what_it_is: Impact of Construction Materials Used for HDB Flats on Noise Transmission

sections.label: HDB noise insulation and mitigation
sections.summary: HDB says no acoustical regulations exist, most residents are satisfied with noise insulation, and it seeks practical mitigation measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: While there are no existing regulations or standards on acoustical performance of building structures, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) is mindful of the needs of residents in this regard.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Based on our survey, the vast majority of residents and respondents have expressed satisfaction with the noise insulation performance of their unit walls and floors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, HDB is continually looking at practical noise mitigation measures for the comfort and well-being of all residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: I should also highlight that in the context of our high-density environment, and with HDB flats designed for natural ventilation, it is not possible to completely sound-proof a unit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Considerate neighbourly behaviour, such as keeping noise levels down, especially at night, will help provide a pleasant living environment for all.
